name: ZCA_ES_ACTIONS
description: This table is used to store the non-localized information for actions

columns.name: ACTION_UUID
columns.description: the primary key

columns.name: META_MODEL_VERSION_UUID
columns.description: Obsolete: the meta model version that this action is for

columns.name: ENTITY_UUID
columns.description: the entity that this action is for

columns.name: ACTION_NAME
columns.description: the unique name for the action

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: the name of the action type, one of CREATE, EDIT, CREATE_RELATED_OBJECT

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y if the action is enabled, otherwise N

columns.name: TASKFLOW_REFERENCE
columns.description: the fully qualified taskflow reference

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_PERMISSION_NAME
columns.description: the name of the functional permission required to perform this action, if any

columns.name: METHOD_PERMISSION_NAMES
columns.description: The names of the method permissions for the action. If non-null, then user must have at least one of these method permissions

columns.name: PRIVILEGE_NAMES
columns.description: The names of all the priviliges that are required for the user to invoke the action

columns.name: PARAMETERS
columns.description: The serialized JSON for the paramters for the taskflow that implements the action

columns.name: KEY_PATH_FOR_PK_OF_ENTITY
columns.description: The key path in the parameters that holds the primary key of the entity that the action is for

columns.name: RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The resource bundle for this action

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_NAME
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized name

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized description

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Specifies the order in which the actions should be displayed for an entity

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the row was deleted, otherwise N

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
